_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Annual Schedule of Inspections and Audits
summary: The Annual Schedule of Inspections and Audits identifies when and where the contractor will perform audits and inspections throughout the year for government tracking and monitoring.
use_relationship:
The Annual Schedule of all Inspections and Audits identifies when and where the contractor will perform audits and inspections throughout the year. It is used by the government to track and monitor the Quality inspections and audits performed or scheduled by the contractor at the Combined Tactical Training Ranges (CTTR).
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Annual Schedule of Inspections and Audits shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The schedule shall include the following:

children.title: All audits, inspections, and assessments which are planned for the contract year, regardless of who will be performing them.
and other designator to permit quick recognition of the scope of the inspection and audit.
All audits that will be performed by the Quality Manager at each site.
The type of inspection and audit to be performed, (i.e., Technical, Safety, Procedural (Process), statistical process control, analyses, corrective action, or follow-up on pending actions, etc.).
The month(s) when the inspection and audit is planned.
Identify the scope, plans, procedures, work instructions, and check sheets that will be used.

All changes and updates to the initial Schedule for the purpose of rescheduling and clearly identify all cancellations, postponements, and rescheduling as well as re-inspections to close out previous findings.
Justifications for rescheduled or postponed audits.
The date and time that all changes were made to the schedule and the name of the person making the change.
The associated work order(s) used to track cost shall be included.
Identify all updates to the schedule to reflect completed audits, and identify complete with no non-conformities, or complete with non-conformities.
the date audit was scheduled and completed, number of non-conformities, and corresponding non-conformity numbers.
The date for any follow up and re-inspections made due to findings or non-conformities and to verify completion of any corrective action.
